info.title: printpapi API
info.description: The public JSON API of printpapi, source available (Elastic License 2.0). Authentication is a bearer token. An Authorization: Basic header switches the same server to PrintNode-compatible shapes, which this document does not describe: see docs/printnode-compat.md in the repository. Operator routes (/operator/**) are not part of this document. Each operation names its roles in x-roles and the key rights it needs in x-rights (docs/api.md, Key rights).

post.description: Key right Submit (scopes: full, print), or the root token or a session. Ten types: raw_base64, pdf_base64, raw_uri, pdf_uri, raw_uri_post, pdf_uri_post, label_uri, label_base64, label_text, receipt. Never send a PDF to a label printer. Retry with the same idempotency_key: it returns the original job_id.
